query_text: Create a news feed reader app for my phone where I can scroll through the latest stories from a mix of topics I care about, like tech and food, and each story card shows the headline and a small image so I can quickly decide if I want to read it, with a simple way to mark the ones I have already seen so they stop cluttering the feed.

Create a mobile article reader app that reads articles out loud to me so I can listen while I am doing something else, with a nice calm voice and a little bar at the bottom of the reading screen that shows how far along the narration is, and I want it to feel elegant and polished, like something I actually enjoy opening up rather than just a plain text player.

Make a bilingual reading app for my phone that shows an article in two languages at the same time, one on top and one below, so I can compare them as I read, with the two versions staying in sync as I scroll so I never lose my place, and the whole thing should feel clean and literary, like a well-designed book rather than a cluttered translation tool.

Create a reader app for my phone where the comments section on any article is properly organized, with options to sort by most liked or by newest at the top so the good stuff floats up, and the whole comments area should feel warm and inviting to read through, with each comment having a clear author name and timestamp so it feels like a real conversation and not a wall of noise.

A save-for-later reading app for your phone where you tap a little bookmark icon on any article and it gets added to a personal reading list that feels curated and beautiful, almost like a magazine shelf, so when you open the list you see each saved article with its cover image and headline in a warm, tasteful layout that makes you actually want to sit down and read through everything you saved.

Need a mobile article reader app that can translate any article into my preferred language with one tap, so the translated version shows up right there in the same reading experience without jumping to another app or browser tab, and I want the translated text to look just as nice as the original, same clean fonts and spacing, so the reading vibe stays consistent no matter what language I switch to.

Make a mobile reading app with a beautiful dark mode that kicks in when I am reading at night, where the background goes a deep soft dark tone instead of harsh black, the text stays easy on the eyes in a warm off-white, and there is a simple toggle somewhere on the reading screen so I can flip between the light and dark looks depending on where I am and how I feel.

Build a news filter manager app for my phone where I can type in keywords I am tired of seeing, like certain celebrity names or topics I want to avoid, and those words get muted so stories containing them just disappear from my feed, plus I want to be able to block entire topic categories in one go, with a clear list showing everything I have muted so I can edit or remove any entry whenever I want.

Need a news source manager app for my phone that lets me block or unsubscribe from specific publishers in just a tap or two, so their content stops showing up anywhere in my feed, and I want a tidy list of all the sources I follow so I can see at a glance which ones I have blocked and easily undo a block if I change my mind later.

An RSS feed reader app for my phone that lets me upload an OPML file to bring in all my existing subscriptions at once, so I do not have to add each one by hand, with the imported feeds organized into whatever folders were set up in the file, and a clear list screen where I can see all my channels, check when each was last updated, and tap into any one to read the latest posts.

Need a news reader app for my phone that shows me how trustworthy each news source is, with a simple rating next to each publisher's name that tells me whether the source leans left, right, or stays fairly neutral, and also whether it has a good track record for accuracy, so I can quickly decide how much to trust what I am reading and choose sources that are more reliable for my daily news.

Build a paid newsletter manager app for my phone where I can see all the newsletters I subscribe to in one place, including what I pay for each one per month or year and when my renewal dates are, so I can keep track of what I am actually spending on newsletters, and tap into any subscription to go read the latest issue or pause and cancel it right from the app.

Build a topic-following app for my phone where I can search for any topic I am interested in, like space exploration or personal finance, follow it with one tap, and the app then suggests a handful of good sources that cover that topic so I can pick the ones I want to add to my feed, with a clear list on my profile showing all the topics I currently follow and how many sources I have added for each.

Need a news filter app for my phone that lets me choose whether I want to see positive news, neutral reporting, or negative stories so I can skip all the doom and gloom on bad days and just read the uplifting stuff, with a simple selector at the top of my feed where I can switch between those three moods and the feed updates right away to show only the kind of stories I picked.

Need a mobile news app that has a switch I can flip to show only stories that have already been fact-checked, so I stop wasting time reading things that turn out to be wrong or misleading, and when the switch is on each story in the feed should have a small label showing who verified it, so I know the information has actually been checked by someone before it reached me.

A news sorting app for my phone that defaults to showing the very latest stories at the top of the feed, with breaking news flagged clearly so it jumps out when something urgent is happening, and a simple toggle that lets me switch between sorted-by-time and sorted-by-topic so I can quickly find fresh updates on the things I care about without digging through a messy unsorted pile.

A news ranking app for my phone where I can sort my feed by what is getting the most reads or what people are sharing the most right now, so instead of guessing what matters today I can just see what everyone else is actually reading, with a clear number on each story card showing read count or share count, and tabs to switch between the two rankings whenever I want.

Make a mobile news reader app where I can filter articles by how long they are, so when I only have five minutes I can tap a quick-reads option and only see short pieces, and when I have time to sit down I can switch to a long-form option that surfaces the deeper articles, with the app showing an estimated reading time on each story card so I always know what I am committing to before I open it.

Create a mobile news filter app that lets me separate opinion pieces from straight news reporting so I always know what kind of thing I am reading, with a filter at the top of my feed where I can tap to show only factual reporting, only opinion columns, or both mixed together, and each story card should have a small label that says whether it is a news report or someone's personal take before I even open it.

Create a mobile tool for my phone that helps me check whether accessories I am looking at buying will actually work with the device or product I already own, so I can enter my device model and then see a clear yes or no answer for each accessory, along with a short note explaining why something is or is not compatible, so I stop buying things that turn out not to fit.

Make a mobile shopping app that shows stock levels organized by size and color on the product detail screen, so when I pick a size I can immediately see which color options are still in stock and which ones are sold out or nearly gone, with a simple visual indicator on each color that makes it obvious at a glance what is available so I do not add something to my cart only to find out it is out of stock.

Build a mobile shopping checkout app where I can redeem my loyalty points to lower my bill, so when I get to the payment screen it shows me how many points I have and how much money they are worth, and I can decide how many points to use with a simple slider or input, with the total price updating right away so I can see exactly how much I am saving before I confirm the order.

Make a mobile shopping cart app that figures out bundle deals for me automatically, so when I add items that qualify for a buy-two-get-one or a percentage-off deal the discount just appears in the cart without me having to enter a code or do the math myself, with a clear breakdown showing which items triggered the deal and exactly how much I saved so I always know the final price before I pay.

Build a mobile order tracker app where I can see the photo the delivery person took when they dropped off my package, so I have actual proof of where it was left and I do not have to wonder whether it was delivered or just marked delivered by mistake, with the photo showing up clearly on the order detail screen along with the delivery timestamp so I have everything in one place.

A delivery appointment scheduler app for my phone that handles packages needing a signature, where I can pick a time slot from a calendar that shows the available windows for my address, confirm the appointment in a couple of taps, and then get a reminder notification the morning of the delivery so I actually remember to be home, with all my upcoming scheduled deliveries listed clearly on the home screen of the app.
